decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the second V's restrained architectural terminal and preservation of its established structure and slope.
The source changes only the terminal treatment and expressly preserves the second V's established geometry; its height hierarchy remains unchanged.
The same-message MODIFY already records the new Hero V terminal style and the constraint to preserve its established structure and slope.
The same-message MODIFY already records the restrained terminal treatment for the É accent; its literal derivation from the Hero V remains valid.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully records that only the shared terminal is under review while all other established design decisions remain unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully replaces the kerning-study format with the requested comparative terminal interpretations.
The source's selection of Option 2 Balanced Flow is already represented by a same-message MODIFY, and the subsequent terminal study does not alter that kerning choice.
Refining the shared terminal does not revoke or change the existing requirement that the É accent and Hero V peaks align.
The terminal refinement does not change the established shared-baseline relationship.
The source postpones proceeding with material treatment while terminal studies are performed but does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish or its required character.
Changing the shared terminal geometry does not alter which signature elements receive champagne gold.
The terminal study has no effect on the all-caps wordmark treatment.
